thread:
maria: Morning — quick async update from me:

maria: What I did: landed prefetch rewrite (PR #451), ran microbatch perf on small model. p95 went from ~82ms -> ~72ms on our baseline run (approx 12% improvement).

maria: Blocker: kv-evict config is still pending (PR #452) — need that merged before I push the canary.

todd: Nice! Any regressions on throughput or memory?

maria: Throughput steady, memory +~20MB (expected). No functional regressions.

zheng: I can pick up PR452 review now. Anything in particular I should watch for?

maria: Mainly eviction threshold behaviour. We set `evict_threshold=0.65` and `hot_window=120s`. Also added `kv.evictions_per_min` metric. Watch for churn and any ttl mismatches.

pranav: Left two nits on PR451 around lock granularity — not blocking but could reduce occasional GC spikes.

maria: Thanks @pranav — pushed a follow-up to address those. Stress tests still show small GC blips but within SLA.

alexa: I'll hook the bench harness to collect token-level traces and kv metrics for the canary. maria can you paste the exact bench command?

maria: Sure — running locally with:
```
# bench small model, 1000 reqs, seq=256
./bench/run.sh --model small --concurrency 16 --requests 1000 --seq 256 --metrics kv.evictions_per_min,latency.p95
```

todd: @ops-bot please reserve 3 canary nodes for tonight 22:00 PT (r4-8 x3).

ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary nodes reserved: r4-8 x3. Provisioning ETA 21:50.

zheng: I'll review PR452 in ~1h. If green we can merge and kick the canary.

maria: Plan: merge PR452 -> trigger canary on 3 nodes -> run bench harness. If `kv.evictions_per_min` spikes >50/min we rollback automatically.

todd: :thumbsup: I'll be on pager for the window, ping me if rollback needed.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued. start_time=2026-03-18T22:00:00Z

maria: Quick ask — does anyone have the perf dashboard link for today's baseline run? I can't find it in the usual place.

alexa: dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/runs/2026-03-18/bench-437 — I just pushed the run artifacts.

maria: Perfect, will attach results after canary completes. Thanks all — end of my async.
